items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: Streamline Isaac. At that time, he used to go off a lot. And he'd learn all of these different dances and things. And when he'd come back, he would teach them to me.

ctx.x: So he was an extra percussionist? Oh yeah, he played a little, every little thing. Well, let's get back to the- So you first started dancing, you said? Yeah. So that was before you really got into the music. Yeah. So who'd you first dance with? Who were the people you danced with? You must have had a group that you danced with.

Well, we streamlined Isaac. Streamline who? Streamline Isaac. At that time, he used to go off a lot. And he'd learn all of these different dances and things. And when he'd come back, he would teach them to me.
Now who- Where would he go out of town? Yeah, he was traveling.
